finding: With no key, no account, no wallet and no payment, a priced endpoint on the vendor's machine-payments host answers 402 with two payment protocols in one response: a Machine Payments Protocol challenge (WWW-Authenticate: Payment, method tempo, intent charge) and an x402 version 2 document offering USDC on Base, Solana, X Layer or Polygon at 30000 units, which is the $0.03 the vendor's pricing page lists for this endpoint. A second priced endpoint answers the same way at 20000 units, its documented $0.02, and the one documented free endpoint answers 200.
